get.summary: Thống kê và tìm kiếm SQL theo đơn vị lịch sử
get.description: Roles and scope read from active DB assignments, never JWT role claims. VERIFIED achievements and RECORDED awards are separate. REVOKED is invalid. typeId requires kind. academicYearId filters achievements only; kind=AWARD plus academicYearId returns 400. Legacy awards without decision metadata are excluded. CSV requires representative/manager/records officer/admin; pagination ignored for CSV. Each response uses one SQL snapshot.

200.description: Success envelope; aggregates across all pages

distinct_years.description: Distinct recognition years of valid rows per kind and subject type; not an eligibility rule
